text:
toni_pm: quick alignment — acme pilot slate map: customer wants private deploy + guaranteed 50 RPS at 100ms p95. Need runtime/infra/security sign-off on launch criteria and sequencing. Who's free for quick sync? TL;DR: need canary plan + fallback model routing + KMS/HSM plan.

alex_product: bringing this up this morning. do we have final SLO numbers? 50 RPS / 100ms p95 is tight.

maria_eng: 100ms p95 for private is gonna need dedicated capacity + prewarmed pools. For latency-sensitive routes we'll likely need batching disabled. Could we accept 120ms for initial pilot?

sam_runtime: keeping batching off reduces throughput. With dedicated pools + kv-cache warm we can hit 100ms p95 at 50 RPS but need 2x workers reserved. Also need anticipated sequence-length distribution and token mix.

toni_pm: acme says ~90% of calls are short (<64 tokens), ~10% are long. They can accept 120ms initially but want roadmap to 100ms. Action: accept 120ms for pilot, target 100ms for GA — agree?

jasmin_infra: KMS + HSM provisioning doable, but HSM attestation/cert process is ~3w. For pilot we can do customer-managed KMS (BYO) or cloud-KMS fallback if customer doesn't have one.

leo_security: customer policy requires keys in customer KMS or dedicated HSM for GA. Pilot ok with cloud KMS provided strict audit logging and access controls are in place. Will need explicit sign-off before GA.

alex_product: OK — pilot plan then: reserved capacity, BYO KMS or cloud-kms fallback, 120ms p95. Who owns canary and rollback runbook?

maria_eng: I can own canary + rollback. Proposed canary: 5% traffic for 24h, perf checks every 5m, auto-rollback if latency >150ms or error rate >2%. I'll write the runbook.

sam_runtime: I'll add automatic routing fallback to a smaller/quantized model variant when latency spikes. Snippet to include in runbook: 
```
route_policy:
  - condition: latency>130ms
    action: route: model-quant-v1
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for acme-pilot on 4812350000 (UTC) — deployment window requested 02:00-04:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

toni_pm: great. jasmin, can you confirm HSM timeline in #infra by EOD? leo, please add the compliance checklist to the doc: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/acme-pilot (product+eng edit).

jasmin_infra: ack — will post HSM timeline + provisioning notes in #infra by 18:00.

leo_security: adding checklist now. tagging legal for data transfer CLAs. @alex_product please confirm customer will sign CLA.

alex_product: will confirm with customer today and update thread.

maria_eng: one more ask — need a small redacted staging dataset for perf tests. @alex_product can you get a sample by tomorrow?

alex_product: yes, sending a redacted sample to the acme staging bucket by EOD.

toni_pm: thanks all. summary: pilot = 120ms p95, reserved capacity, BYO KMS or cloud fallback, canary owned by maria, runtime fallback owned by sam, infra to confirm HSM timeline. Follow-ups in the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
